review_response_tasks.rationale: It is exciting to learn...评价学习这件事令人兴奋。excite为动词；excited形容人感受而此it为形式主语指学习活动；excitement为名词，此处非用冠词的名词结构。
空后是单数可数名词，结合其开头音素使用an。a与该词的开头音素不合；a few和many要求复数名词，不能直接接本题的单数名词。
every year为习惯，my grandmother单数，teaches作谓语。teach数不符；teaching/to teach不能独立作限定谓语。
two后需要复数名词bowls，且hold ingredients说明盛物容器。bowl/bowlful是单数形式，bowling表示保龄球活动不符容器与two。
clearer比较级后用than。then时间、that指示/连接、as同级比较结构均不合此比较形式。
yesterday明确过去，finished正确。finish/finishes为现在；finishing缺限定助动词。
名词性物主代词yours作表语表示“你们的画”，与write your names呼应。your缺所修饰名词；you不表示归属；yourself为反身单数而非画的归属。
how to make为疑问词+不定式结构。how making缺本句连接结构；made/makes不能在该showed us how后独立形成此补语。
There be中many useful ideas复数用are。is数不合；has/have不能作该存在句的be谓语。
become interested in doing表达对尝试饭菜产生兴趣。on/at/of不构成本句搭配。

completed_passage:
Our class is making a little book about family meals. It is exciting to learn how different families cook the same dish. We do not need an expensive camera. We draw simple pictures beside the recipes instead.

Each pupil asks a family member about one meal. My grandmother teaches me her favourite recipe every year, and this time I wrote it down. She uses two small bowls to hold the ingredients. I put a number beside every step so readers can follow the order. This way is clearer than writing everything in one long sentence.

We finished the first pages yesterday. Ms Lin said, “These lovely pictures are yours, so write your names below them.” She then showed us how to make a simple contents page. There are many useful ideas in our book already. We want more families to become interested in trying one another's meals. We are sharing family stories, not saying that one family's way is the only right way.
